name: K-Radar — 4D Radar Object Detection Dataset
description: High-resolution 4D radar object detection benchmark created by the Autonomous Vehicle Laboratory at KAIST. Features 35,000 synchronized frames of 4D radar tensors (Range-Azimuth-Elevation-Doppler), 128-channel LiDAR point clouds, 4 surround cameras, and RTK-GPS navigation data. Collected in diverse adverse weather conditions including heavy snow, dense fog, rain, and sleet across urban roads, highways, and tunnels, providing 3D bounding boxes for robust weather-resilient perception.
